method: Independent in-session fundamental analyst, exact stored fundamentals system prompt applied; dated issuer evidence replaces undated financial-statement trend claims.

sources.title: SOP latest observed issuer financial/fund disclosure
observed_facts: Q2 revenue RM1.458bn versus RM1.307bn; owners profit RM153.686m versus RM91.917m (+67.2%). H1 owners profit increased only 6%.
Derived Q2 owners-profit/revenue ratio 10.54% versus 7.03%; H1 ratio 7.51%, so quarterly recovery should not be extrapolated.
NAV/share RM4.75 versus RM4.60; latest borrowings and FCF not independently extracted.
limitations: Issuer-authored Bursa financial summary accessed through third-party mirror; issuer IR points to Bursa but original PDF is blocked. Latest primary balance-sheet/cash-flow details unavailable; no media causal claims used as verified facts.
Vendor statement timing metadata absent; no snapshot YoY financial trend inferred.
Forward P/E is a vendor estimate, not realised earnings or intrinsic value.
Neutral/low: latest issuer/exchange document itself inaccessible; mirrored summary is identified, not treated as equivalent to full primary PDF access.
